text:
saira_csm: Quick ask 1-pager ops handout for customers that covers warm-prefill, delta-sync, cache TTL guidance, batch heuristics, streaming fallbacks, and a tiny feedback hook. Want to pilot with 2 accounts this week.
ben_platform: Keep it prescriptive and copy-pasteable. Include one short YAML prefill (3 lines) and one batching heuristic line.
saira_csm: Draft checklist idea: 1) Account health snapshot (owner: CSM) 2) Prefill: run 24h before demo with jittered client start times 3) Delta-sync: sliding window 7m for most customers, 3m for high-change tenants 4) Cache TTLs: snippets=12h, static-profile=7d 5) Batch heuristic: target ~1024 tokens or max 8 concurrent requests 6) Streaming fallback: short-answer stub if generation >1.1s 7) Feedback hook: quick 1-question survey after 5 live replies.
mina_sre: Add SLO note: if p50 interactive >300ms, reduce batch target by 25% and enable prefix-KV cache. Escalation: renewal_risk_score>0.65 + sustained latency increase -> schedule 30-min triage.
ben_platform: tiny prefill example to hand customers:
```yaml
job: prefill-brief
schedule: "24h-before-launch"
prompt_set: tenant_samples
cache_ttl: 43200
```
ben_platform: batching heuristic (one-liner): "Aim for ~1k tokens per batch or cap concurrency at 8; small bursts OK but prefer steady steady-state"
saira_csm: feedback hook text (CSM copy-paste): "Quick check: Did the assistant answers match what you expected? (Yes / No) Optional: add one sentence of feedback." Store in ticketing and tag prompt_set.
mina_sre: streaming note: set keepalive=30s, chunked=true. If streams stall >10s, short-circuit to cached/templated response and log event for triage.
triage-bot: Reminder posted: share final one-pager to #customer-success-docs in 24h.
saira_csm: Thanks everyone 1'll assemble the 1-pager and run with two pilots. Will report outcomes next Monday.
